notes.title: v1.2.0 - UE5, DLSS/FSR, VR/general fixes, and more!
notes.content:
Added:

 Sound configuration menu (changes still pending)
 DLSS and FSR, as well as their settings in the start menu
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662185/7b8c0581ac35831ac6e759f4bb3a9959d9cd13e5.png
 Frame counter in pause menu
 Audio configuration that allows changing audio device (volume modification pending)
 Inspection (with the N key, the key to turn on the flashlight is now L)
 Added map The House
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662185/f794909361024ac1e14028d43d16dd3745881e3c.png
 Doors with replicated physics: They can be closed with the action button (F)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662185/5313d31fe9df13378fb2300e2439446d3d1826c5.png
 New SV8 sniper rifle: It has an integrated scope that allows you to accurately hit long shots
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662185/3bbc6e6bbcce5dd3ddc032dcd6b3359839ce3c87.png
 Universal magazines for all weapons: In addition to the fact that you can carry 5 useful magazines for any of the weapons you use the most, they allow you to adapt the gameplay to another level. Be careful, as you might forget to reload your other weapon and you won't have any magazines to make up for it.
 Backpack: An item spawner that recharges automatically over time. Allows you to regenerate health, spawn weapons and ammunition at the cost of energy


Changed:

 IMPORTANT! Game engine changed to Unreal Engine 5
 General physics adjusted slightly
 The player's perspective changed slightly
 Migrated to Lumen Global Illumination System
 Migrated to Nanite system
 Respawn time set to 3 seconds
 Adjusted respawn points on most maps
 Improved the Building map
 Improved concrete textures in Building and Limbo
 Improved enemy AI
 New bleeding system: Bleeding level now depends on the damage received
 Physics Hit System: Objects that have active physics can hit the player and deal damage.
 Recreated and improved the AR142 model
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662185/39ae659bd50a0962e8a1c1bc515c80e0efa552a2.png


Fixed:

 The interaction point of the menus within the games is now shown
 Graphics settings are now saved
 Player items bugged when physics were activated and the player died
 The player can now climb on top of objects with physics

notes.title: v1.1.3 - Improvement Update
notes.content:
Added:

 A pointing sphere in non-VR menus allows for easier interaction
 FPS limit in settings
 Fade when you get too close to an object to avoid looking through objects
 Loading indicator when creating game
 Now physics are activated when falling from a certain distance
 An item and health generator that runs on energy that charges over time (WIP)


Changed:

 Improved Building map
 Improved Horde map
 Improved the sky in Center
 Changed and improved AI behavior, now they can shoot while moving and escape from the player when unarmed
 Modified menu textures


Fixed:

 Crashing when continuous recharging without equipped magazines
 Fixed voice chat, still need to add audio device selector
 Some changes to replication in virtual reality
 Bleeding is now removed correctly when body is removed
 Crouching in virtual reality modifies the body (changes still pending)
 Visual lag when physics are activated
 Aiming guns is now better

notes.title: v1.1.2 - VR fixes and Explosive Barrels
notes.content:
Added:

 Graphic configuration menu
 Laser when aiming in VR menus
 Multiplayer Barrels: Explosives from Survival mode are now multiplayer ready on the Center map
 Sounds when reloading weapons
 Sounds when trying to fire an empty gun


Changed:

 Magazine demise time increased to 30 seconds
 Grab mode is now holding the F key (previously had to be pressed once per grab attempt)
 Increased grab distance in VR
 Weapon recoil slightly decreased
 Now there is a moon on the map Center


Fixed:

 A bug in VR that caused you to drop weapons by grabbing them with your other hand and then releasing with your previous one
 Huge fixes to VR controls

notes.title: v1.1.1 - New map and bug fixes
notes.content:
Added:

 Camera movement when idle, walking and running
 New Map: Center


Changed:

 The character's texture is now white!
 AR142 rifle rate of fire slightly reduced
 AR142 rifle and C22 pistol sounds
 Post process effect


Fixed:

 Head blocking player's view when performing multiple actions
 Fixed a bug where the weapon type would change when switching weapons
 Small changes to flashlight position when aiming
 Weapon physics replication is now better
 AI weapons were being destroyed by the Clear menu

notes.title: 1.1 Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42662185/bb6163ee75b9f8e7b1240b546128c1525789d161.png
Various general improvements, map changes (forest and survival), AI improvements, and more have been added in this update.


 New AR 142 assault rifle: Excellent for close combat, and with sufficient precision for use at medium distances.
 Added Explosive Barrels for Survival Map: Be careful if you get too close, you can die instantly, and at close range you will be thrown into the air. Use them against the hordes of enemies.
 AI can now have an Assault Rifle equipped.
 Forest map rain has been improved.
 The appearance of the C22 pistol was improved.
 Fixed some visual bugs when dying.


And some other fixes that focus on improving the quality of gaming experience.

notes.title: v1.0.1 - Single player survival mode
notes.content:
Update Notes:

The mechanics to invite friends within the game have been added.
VR gameplay has been improved.
Single player mode (beta) has been added. Warning, it contains multiple bugs that will be fixed as soon as possible.
